Public layout validation calls the full check from zero; the generator uses the accepted prefix and truncates rejected candidate groups.

Occupancy keeps counts and a change token for removal; graph reachability and furniture access are checked before accepting each candidate. The validity of all source identities, conversions, edge geometry, mutation and every alternate producer remains open.

Roles 637–638 select furniture candidate groups by budget and deterministic score, preserve explicit unmet budgets, recompute paths when validating serialized layout, and apply room-facing heuristics. Branches that reject candidates, numerical limits, access semantics and producer aliases require further independent review.
